use: The perf lab's test key for signed flags documents (plans/cmux-next/chrome-parity/p12-perf-process.md section 3.9). Only bench builds (CMUX_BENCH_HOOKS) trust its public key (FeatureRemoteSignatureCheck.benchTestPublicKey); a shipped app does not, and check-no-bench-hooks.sh refuses a shipped app whose executable contains it. Not a secret: never sign anything a shipped app reads with it.
